items.title: Motorola Solutions Leadership Discusses AI Adoption at WeAreDevelopers Conference India
items.summary: Anudeep Muttavarapu, Country Head and Managing Director of Motorola Solutions, participated in the inaugural WeAreDevelopers Conference India to discuss AI integration and organizational strategy.
items.content: On November 26, 2026, Anudeep Muttavarapu, the Country Head and Managing Director of Motorola Solutions, spoke at the WeAreDevelopers Conference India held in Bengaluru. During his session, he compared the current adoption of artificial intelligence to the historical transition from steam power to electric motors in manufacturing, emphasizing that organizations must redesign their roles and skill sets to fully realize the benefits of AI. His remarks were part of a broader industry discussion on the future of software development and human-agent collaboration. The event brought together thousands of developers and tech leaders to explore the impact of AI agents on global enterprise landscapes.

items.title: All Indian Cine Workers Association Demands Ban on Netflix's Pakistani Series
items.summary: The All Indian Cine Workers Association (AICWA) has formally requested that the Indian government block the release of Netflix's upcoming Pakistani original series, 'Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo'.
items.content: The All Indian Cine Workers Association (AICWA) has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi urging a ban on the release of the Netflix original series 'Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo' in India. The series, which is Pakistan's first Netflix original, is scheduled for a global premiere on December 4. The association argues that the release would disregard the sentiments of families affected by terrorism and has also called for legislation to prohibit Pakistani entertainment content in India. Netflix has not yet clarified whether the series will be made available to its Indian subscribers.

items.title: Oil Sands Alliance Evaluates Impact of New Federal Tax Deduction on Pathways Carbon Capture Project
items.summary: The Oil Sands Alliance, including Imperial Oil, is assessing how a newly announced federal 'Productivity Mega Deduction' could support the development of the Pathways carbon capture and storage project.
items.content: Kendall Dilling, president of the Oil Sands Alliance, stated that the federal government's new 'Productivity Mega Deduction' could help address significant financial barriers facing the proposed Pathways carbon capture and storage project. The project, which involves Imperial Oil and other major energy companies, aims to include carbon-capture facilities at multiple oil sands operations, a shared CO₂ transportation pipeline, and a storage hub in the Cold Lake region. Dilling noted that the tax measure, which allows for the immediate deduction of capital equipment costs, may improve the project's competitiveness for capital. The alliance continues to work toward binding agreements for the project, which is designed to capture and store approximately six million tonnes of CO₂ annually.

items.title: NASA Takes Ownership of X-59 Supersonic Aircraft
items.summary: NASA has officially taken ownership of the X-59 experimental supersonic aircraft from Lockheed Martin, marking a significant milestone in the development of quiet supersonic flight.
items.content: NASA has formally accepted the X-59 aircraft from Lockheed Martin, transitioning the experimental vehicle into the next phase of its mission to demonstrate quiet supersonic flight over land. The handover represents a major milestone for the project, which aims to gather data that could eventually lead to the lifting of current bans on commercial supersonic flight over populated areas. Lockheed Martin developed the aircraft as part of a collaborative effort to reduce the sonic boom to a quieter sound. The transition allows NASA to begin its own flight testing and research operations with the vehicle.

items.title: J-Star Holding Announces Strategy to Evaluate U.S. Automation and System Integration Partners
items.summary: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd. is actively seeking U.S.-based industrial automation and system integration partners to support the development of localized manufacturing capabilities for advanced carbon fiber composite products.
items.content: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd. announced it is evaluating U.S.-based companies with industrial automation and system integration capabilities as potential strategic acquisition targets, joint venture partners, or long-term engineering partners. This initiative is part of the company's broader strategy to establish localized U.S. manufacturing and develop automated production lines for advanced carbon fiber composite products. The company aims to leverage domestic engineering design, electrical control systems, and turnkey line-commissioning capabilities to support the production of structural components for applications such as unmanned aerial vehicles. items.title: Upland Resources Provides Operational Update on Wild Mustang Gas Development
items.summary: Upland Resources Limited reported progress on the GMF-5 well at the Wild Mustang Federal Unit in Wyoming, noting ongoing drilling and infrastructure development.
items.content: Upland Resources Limited announced that the GMF-5 well, the third well at the Wild Mustang Federal Unit in Wyoming, has reached a depth of approximately 13,000 feet toward a planned total depth of 19,700 feet. The company reported gas shows in the Fort Union and Upper Sussex formations, though these intervals are not currently included in existing gas-in-place estimates. Additionally, the five-mile gas sales pipeline is approximately 80% complete, with connection to existing infrastructure anticipated in December 2026, pending final construction and approvals. Upland has invested approximately US$4.3 million in the project through its subsidiary, Upland Resources (Wyoming) Ltd., and retains an option to invest up to an additional US$9.5 million through December 31, 2030.

items.summary: Gulf Resources, Inc. has entered into an agreement for its subsidiary, Shouguang City Haoyuan Chemical Company Limited (SCHC), to acquire bromine and crude salt assets from the collective economic organization of Caiyangzi Village.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, Gulf Resources, Inc. announced that it and its wholly owned subsidiary, SCHC, signed a purchase agreement to acquire bromine and crude salt assets located in Shouguang City. The transaction includes 1.29 square kilometers of crude salt fields and is valued at approximately RMB 103.5 million (roughly $14 million). The company expects the acquisition to expand its production capacity for bromine and crude salt. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions, including a satisfactory asset assessment, with a targeted closing date of December 31, 2026.

items.title: Concord Medical Receives NYSE Non-Compliance Letter Regarding Delayed Financial Filings
items.summary: Concord Medical Services Holdings Limited has been notified by the NYSE of non-compliance with listing standards due to the delayed filing of restated financial statements for fiscal years 2024 and 2025.
items.content: Concord Medical Services Holdings Limited announced that it received a letter from the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) on November 23, 2026, indicating non-compliance with Section 802.01E of the NYSE Listed Company Manual. The notification stems from the company's failure to file restated financial statements for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2024, and 2025, including amended Annual Reports on Form 20-F, within the required timeframe. This restatement is necessary to reflect the deconsolidation of Concord Healthcare Group Co., Ltd. effective in 2024, following a prior SEC staff request. The company is currently working with independent auditors to complete the restatements and expects to file the delayed reports by December 31, 2026. The NYSE notification does not result in immediate delisting or trading suspension, and the company will be listed as a late filer with an "LF" indicator until compliance is regained.

items.title: ExxonMobil Files Disclosure Regarding Threshold Crossing in Esso S.A.F.
items.summary: ExxonMobil informed the French financial markets authority (AMF) that its stake in Esso S.A.F. has fallen below multiple ownership thresholds following the completion of a previously announced block acquisition.
items.content: ExxonMobil France Holding SAS notified the AMF that its participation in Esso S.A.F. has crossed below the 2/3, 50%, 1/3, 30%, 25%, 20%, 15%, 10%, and 5% thresholds of capital and voting rights. This disclosure follows the completion of the sale of its stake in the company, which was part of an agreement announced on May 28, 2025, involving the acquisition of an 82.89% block of Esso S.A.F. and 100% of ExxonMobil Chemical France. The transaction was finalized on November 28, 2025, at a final price of 26.19 € per share, following various adjustments and distributions. The current filing serves as a formal regulatory update regarding the change in ownership status.

By pairing the Amazon Quick agentic workspace with structured delivery engagements, the CoE aims to move clients beyond business intelligence into autonomous workload management.

items.title: Reports Indicate McDonald's App Sending Unauthorized Notifications
items.summary: Users have reported receiving promotional push notifications and Live Activities from the McDonald's app even when notifications are disabled.
items.content: Reports have emerged indicating that the McDonald's mobile app is sending promotional push notifications and utilizing Live Activities to display advertisements to iPhone users, even when those users have explicitly disabled notification permissions. The issue, which has also been observed with other retail and restaurant apps, raises questions regarding compliance with Apple's App Store guidelines, which generally prohibit the use of push notifications for marketing without user consent. While the technical cause remains unclear, the reports suggest a potential conflict between app functionality and iOS notification settings.

items.title: Families File Lawsuit Against Uber Following Fatal Arizona Collision
items.summary: Families of victims involved in a 2025 Arizona car crash have filed a lawsuit against Uber, alleging negligence in driver screening and supervision.
items.content: A lawsuit has been filed in Pima County Superior Court against Uber Technologies, Inc. following a fatal October 2025 collision in Tucson, Arizona. The complaint alleges that the company failed to adequately screen, qualify, train, and supervise the driver involved in the accident, which resulted in the deaths of four individuals, including two Uber passengers and a minor. The plaintiffs contend that Uber did not exercise reasonable care in monitoring its drivers, raising concerns about the company's safety protocols for transporting passengers. The litigation seeks to address these alleged failures and hold the company accountable for the incident.

items.title: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. Appoints Cheng Sin Yi as Co-Chief Executive Officer
items.summary: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. has appointed Cheng Sin Yi as Co-Chief Executive Officer, effective November 21, 2026, as part of a leadership transition.
items.content: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. (Nasdaq: NXAT) announced the appointment of Ms. Cheng Sin Yi as Co-Chief Executive Officer, effective November 21, 2026. As part of this leadership change, Myungjong Kim has stepped down from his role as of the same date, and current Co-CEO Ted Kim is scheduled to step down at the beginning of next year. Ms. Cheng brings over 15 years of experience in finance, corporate management, and capital markets to the company. The company stated that her appointment is intended to strengthen its financial foundation, governance, and efforts to meet Nasdaq continued listing requirements.
